reviews.title: Love them
reviews.comment: Arctic is usually my go to for liquid coolers and I didn’t think their fans would be any less quality and I’m glad I bought these. They were bought for a customer build that wanted the stealthy, no RGB build. They keep temps cool, look nice, are well priced, and very quiet
reviews.author: Christian Zaccaria

reviews.title: Very good value
reviews.comment:
Great value for the money. Bench still rank them 2nd after noctua, at a price point worth considering when you have to buy 7 of those.
Adjust pwm mode accordingly to avoid spinning them at full speed, too much for an atx case and consequently keep the noise level low.
reviews.author: Julien

reviews.title: Genuinely Impressed
reviews.comment: Genuinely impressed how just how quiet and how powerful these fans are. They pump out some serious CFM
reviews.author: Nicolas T.

reviews.title: Works
reviews.comment: Heard mixed reviews about ARTIC  fans but I needed a reverse fan on the cheap. Works great for my needs. Time will tell if it holds up
